description:
Debut full length from Bells Atlas credits:
released 18 June 2013 
All songs written and produced by Bells Atlas 
Bells Atlas is: 
Derek Barber- Guitar 
Geneva Harrison- Drums, Mallets & Percussion 
Sandra Lawson-Ndu- Lead Vocals 
Doug Stuart- Bass, Vocals 
All additional percussion and sounds by the collective 

Lyrics by Sandra Lawson-Ndu except "Capable People" by Sandra Lawson-Ndu and Doug Stuart 

Bateria arrangement by Geneva Harrison 

Guest Musicians: 
"Incessant Noise": Nico Bell, Mark Clifford, Aaron Gold, Andrew Maguire
"Rain" : Rob Ewing (trombone), Aram Shelton (Tenor Sax) 
"Jyeah" : Anton Estaniel (Cello), Jacob Hansen-Joseph (Viola), 
Bob LaDue (Chekeres) 
"Video Star" : Hannah Van Loon (Violin), 
"Kazoo" : Anton Estaniel (Cello), Jacob Hansen-Joseph (Viola), 
Theo Padovus (Trumpet) 
"Dit Dit" : Jacob Hansen-Joseph (Viola) 

All songs recorded, mixed, and co-produced by Carlos Arredondo 
at New Improved Recording Oakland, CA. 
except: "Loving You Down" recorded, mixed, and co-produced by Eli Crews at New Improved Recording 
"Untitled" recorded and mixed by Bijan Sharifi 
All songs mastered by Bijan Sharifi 

Photography and artwork by Ginger Fierstein
www.gingerfphotography.com 
All songs © Bells Atlas
